pilot_exclusion: All 13 run-01/pilot attempts excluded as a whole after detecting ambient skill-context budget truncation; none selected based on answer quality. Original traces and attempts retained.

transport_retry_policy.eligibility: Nonzero exit, no output, no observed usage, confirmed provider capacity failure only; same rule for both arms. No successful answer rerolls.

generation_smoke.selection: first generation per arm, no rerolls; preselected before answer text inspection
generation_smoke.input: standalone final prompt only, no reference image attached
generation_smoke.known_limits: Backend model ID and seed are not exposed; label as tool workflow smoke, not verified GPT Image 2.5 API execution.

blind_review.type: independent model agents with fresh context
blind_review.rubric: Five independent-design acceptance criteria per case, each 0/1/2; equal weights. No reward for length, framework names or headings.
blind_review.winner: A/B if higher total, otherwise tie. Both reviewers score before receiving the identity key.
blind_review.disclosure: Model/agent review is not human review; no human signature or approval is fabricated.
